title: Windgrace | Planeswalker
description: Learn more about the Planeswalker Windgrace, from Magic: The Gathering.

paragraphs.text: Lord Windgrace, a panther warrior Planeswalker and one of Urza’s Nine Titans united against Phyrexia, despises the destructive power of artifice. He sacrificed his life to protect his home of Urborg, but not before binding his soul to the land and vowing to always watch over it.
